info.title: invowerk
info.description: German e-invoice checker: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDFs incl. PDF/A, XRechnung via the KoSIT validator, Peppol BIS. Free web tool, API, MCP.

get.summary: Your plan remaining requests and remaining credits
get.description:
Check where you stand before a call fails.

Returns the plan this request runs on and whether your key was recognized.
Without an `X-API-Key`, the call runs anonymously at the rate limit for
calls without a key. It also returns the requests left in the current window
and the features your plan includes. On plans priced in credits, it returns
the credits left in the current billing period.

This call does not count against your rate limit, so the numbers it reports
are the numbers you have.

**Credits:** free. This endpoint is not metered.

post.summary: Read an e invoice into JSON
post.description:
Read an existing e-invoice into JSON keyed on EN 16931 Business Terms.

The JSON in `model` is the request body of `POST /v1/generate`, so you can edit
it and create the invoice again. Send an XML invoice (UBL or CII) or a
ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF as the raw request body or as a multipart file part, at
most 20 MB. A PDF may have at most 500 pages and 16 attachments. UBL credit
notes are not supported. The answer also has `detection` (syntax, flavor,
CustomizationID) and `source` (`xml` or `pdf-embedded`). A file that cannot be
read returns 422; `detail` starts with an error code. More than 100,000 XML
elements return 413; 429 means every slot is busy (callers without an API key
share one), 504 that reading took longer than 20 s. Costs 2 credits.

**Credits:** 2 per call.

post.summary: Convert an e invoice between UBL and CII
post.description:
Convert an e-invoice between UBL and CII.

Send the invoice as for `POST /v1/parse`: XML or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF, raw
body or multipart file part, at most 20 MB. `target_syntax` is required (`ubl`
or `cii`). `target_flavor` (`en16931` or `xrechnung`) is optional; without it
the flavor of the source is kept. invowerk checks the converted XML before
answering and never returns an invalid document. The answer is
`application/xml`; `?format=json` returns `{xml, syntax, flavor,
self_validation}`. Errors: 422 when the input cannot be read, with an error code
at the start of `detail`; 500 when the converted XML fails the check (the
credits are refunded); 413, 429 and 504 as for `POST /v1/parse`. Costs 3
credits.

**Credits:** 3 per call.

parameters.name: target_syntax
parameters.description: The XML syntax to convert to: 'cii' or 'ubl'.

parameters.name: target_flavor
parameters.description: Optional rule set of the result: 'en16931' or 'xrechnung'. Without it the flavor of the source is kept.

200.description: The converted XML (default) or the JSON object (?format=json).

post.summary: Create an e invoice from JSON
post.description:
Create an EN 16931 e-invoice from JSON.

The JSON body is keyed on EN 16931 Business Terms (BT-*). `syntax` selects UBL
(default) or CII. `flavor` selects plain EN 16931 (default) or XRechnung, which
requires `buyer_reference` (BT-10, the Leitweg-ID). invowerk writes your
amounts as given. It does not compute or correct them. Before answering,
invowerk checks the generated XML and never returns an invalid document. The
answer is `application/xml`; `?format=json` returns
`{xml, syntax, flavor, self_validation}`. Errors: 422 for invalid input, with
details per field; 500 when the generated XML fails the check (the credits are
refunded); 429 when every slot is busy (callers without an API key share
one); 504 when it took longer than 20 s. Costs 5 credits.

**Credits:** 5 per call.

200.description: The generated XML (default) or the JSON object (?format=json).

get.description:
Explain rule codes and invowerk's own `IW-*` Hinweise in German or English.

For each code the answer has the title, what the rule requires, common causes,
how to fix the invoice, the affected Business Terms and `explain_url`, the path
of the German page under `/codes/`. The codes appear in `findings` and `hints`
of `POST /v1/validate`. If any code has no explanation, the answer is HTTP 404
and names those codes. Costs 0 credits; an API key is not needed and does not
raise the rate limit.

**Credits:** free. This endpoint is not metered.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: One or more codes; repeat the parameter: ?code=BR-DE-21&code=IW-IBAN.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the explanation, `de` or `en`. Without it, the Accept-Language header decides, otherwise German.

post.summary: Render an e invoice as HTML
post.description:
Render an XML e-invoice as a readable HTML page.

Send an XML invoice (UBL or CII, e.g. XRechnung) as the raw request body or as
a multipart `file` part. PDFs are not accepted. invowerk renders it with the
KoSIT XRechnung visualization and answers with `text/html`; `?format=json`
returns `{html, lang, flavor, syntax}` instead. `lang` sets the label language
(`de` or `en`; otherwise `Accept-Language`, then `de`). Errors: 400 for an
empty body, 415 for a file that is not an XML invoice, 422 for malformed XML or
a DOCTYPE, 413 for more than 100,000 elements, 429 when every render slot is
busy (callers without an API key share one), 504 when the render ran longer
than 20 s. Costs 1 credit.

**Credits:** 1 per call.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Label language, 'de' or 'en'. Default: Accept-Language, then 'de'.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The invoice XML as a multipart file part.

200.description: The rendered HTML (default) or the JSON object (?format=json).

post.description:
Check an e-invoice against EN 16931 and the German rules.

Send an XML invoice (UBL or CII, e.g. XRechnung) or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF as
the raw request body or as a multipart file part, at most 20 MB. A PDF may have
at most 500 pages and 16 attachments. invowerk detects the format from the
bytes, not from the Content-Type. A larger body gets HTTP 413. Otherwise the
answer is always HTTP 200, because a failed check is a result, not an error.
`valid` is the result, `findings` lists each problem, `e_rechnung_de` maps the
result onto the BMF categories and `evidence` identifies the checked file.
`hints` are extra observations that never change `valid`. For XRechnung the
KoSIT validator decides `valid`. If it is unreachable, invowerk's own check
with the same rules decides, `verdict_source` is `local` and the
`X-EInvoice-Degraded` header is set (`official-lane-unavailable`;
`pdfa-lane-unavailable` when the PDF/A check did not answer; comma-separated).
`disagreement` is true when both checks ran and differ. For a PDF,
`pdfa_verdict` is the PDF/A check with veraPDF. `?explain=true` adds the
explanation for rules that have one, in `lang` (`de` or `en`). An XML file
with more than 100,000 elements gets HTTP 413. HTTP 429 means every check
slot is busy (callers without an API key share one), HTTP 504 that the check
ran longer than 20 s. Costs 1 credit.

**Credits:** 1 per call.

ContentClass.description:
Reminder that the content of an invoice cannot be checked by machine.

It never contains findings. A clean result means the invoice is well-formed
and follows the rules. It does not mean that prices, amounts or the
delivered service are correct.

note.description: Fixed note: a format check cannot judge whether the content is correct.

ConvertResponse.description: The answer of POST /v1/convert?format=json: the XML and the check result.

syntax.description: The syntax of the XML: 'ubl' or 'cii'.

flavor.description: The rule set of the XML: 'en16931' or 'xrechnung'.

ConvertSelfValidation.description:
The result of invowerk's own check of the converted XML.

It shows that the XML passed the check before it was returned. An invalid
result returns HTTP 500 instead.

valid.description: Always true. An invalid result returns HTTP 500 instead.

finding_count.description: Number of findings of the check; all of them are non-fatal.

CreditsInfo.description:
Your credit balance for the current billing period. `granted` is what
your plan included, `balance` what is still unspent, and `period_end` the
date (ISO 8601) your allowance refills. Present only on plans that are
priced in credits.

line_total.description: Sum of the line net amounts (BT-106).

payable.description: Amount due for payment (BT-115). Defaults to the total with VAT.

ERechnungDe.description:
The result mapped onto the categories of the BMF letter of 15.10.2025
(Germany).

It describes the format check only. It is not a tax assessment (see
``note``).

status.description: 'e_rechnung' (no errors), 'e_rechnung_mit_fehlern' (rule errors), 'keine_e_rechnung' (not a structured e-invoice) or 'nicht_pruefbar' (the file could not be checked).

reason.description: Why this status applies, in German, naming the finding.

basis.description: The BMF letter or UStAE passage for the category; null for 'nicht_pruefbar'.

note.description: Fixed German note, the same on every answer: invowerk checks the technical format, not whether content and amounts are correct or what tax consequences an error has.

ErrorClasses.description:
The findings grouped by where the problem is. ``findings`` has the same
findings as one list.

format.description: Problems with the file or XML structure: unknown format, malformed XML, a forbidden DOCTYPE, XML schema (XSD) errors.

business_rules.description: Failed rules of the applied rule set (EN 16931, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X or Peppol BIS).

carrier.description: Problems with the PDF of a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X invoice: PDF/A conformance and how the XML is embedded (BR-HYBRID-* rules). Always empty for an XML file.

Evidence.description:
Which file was checked, when, and with which software. Keep it with a
saved report: the SHA-256 ties the report to one file.

document_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes you sent (compare with `sha256sum <file>`).

document_bytes.description: Size in bytes of what you sent.

checked_at.description: UTC time of the check, ISO 8601 to the second, e.g. '2026-09-24T10:15:00Z'.

ExplainResponse.description:
The answer of GET /v1/explain: one explanation per requested code.

Pass several codes with repeated ``?code=`` parameters. If any code is
unknown, the call returns HTTP 404 and names it; there is no partial
answer.

explanations.description: One explanation per requested code, in request order, duplicates removed.

Finding.description:
One problem found in the invoice.

``error_class`` says where the problem is: in the file or XML structure
(``format``), in a rule of the applied rule set (``business_rules``) or in
the PDF around the invoice data (``carrier``). ``explain_url`` links the
explanation page for the code, in ``lang``. ``explain`` holds the explanation
itself when you call with ``?explain=true``.

rule_id.description: Code of the rule that failed, e.g. 'BR-DE-21', or 'XSD' for a schema error.

error_class.description: Where the problem is: 'format' (file or XML structure), 'business_rules' (a rule of the applied rule set) or 'carrier' (the PDF around the XML).

xpath.description: Where the problem is in the XML (an XPath or a schema line), if known.

message.description: The message of the failed rule or check.

explain_url.description: Path of the explanation page /codes/<CODE> (/en/codes/<CODE> in English), if invowerk has one.

explain.description: Explanation of the rule (meaning, causes, fixes) in the requested language. Set only with ?explain=true and if invowerk has an entry for the code.

Flavor.description: The rule set the invoice follows: plain EN 16931, or XRechnung (German rules).

GenerateRequest.description:
The request body of POST /v1/generate: an EN 16931 invoice, keyed on
Business Terms (BT-*).

All amounts are your own figures. invowerk writes them into the XML and
checks the result against EN 16931 (and XRechnung, if selected). It does not
compute or correct them.

invoice_type_code.description: Invoice type code from UNTDID 1001; '380' is a commercial invoice (BT-3).

buyer_reference.description: Buyer reference, in Germany often the Leitweg-ID (BT-10). Required for flavor 'xrechnung' (BR-DE-15), optional for plain EN 16931.

payment_iban.description: IBAN of the payee account for a bank transfer (BT-84).

tax_breakdown.description: One or more VAT breakdowns, one per VAT category and rate (BG-23).

GenerateResponse.description: The answer of POST /v1/generate?format=json: the XML and the check result.

syntax.description: The syntax of the XML: 'ubl' or 'cii'.

flavor.description: The rule set of the XML: 'en16931' or 'xrechnung'.

HintInfo.description: One hint: an extra observation by invowerk. Hints never change the result.

severity.description: 'warning' or 'information'. A hint is never fatal.

message.description: The observation, in the requested language.

bt_refs.description: The EN 16931 Business Terms the hint is about.

explain_url.description: Path of the page /codes/<CODE> (/en/… in English) that explains the hint.

unit_code.description: Unit code from UN/ECE Recommendation 20; 'C62' means 'one' (BT-130).

line_net_amount.description: Line net amount, quantity × net price, as you state it (BT-131).

tax_category.description: VAT category code of the line, e.g. 'S' for standard rate (BT-151).

tax_rate.description: VAT rate of the line in percent, e.g. 19.00 (BT-152).

MeResponse.description:
The `GET /v1/me` payload: who the request is authenticated as, what is
left of your request and credit allowances, and which features your plan
includes.

tier.description: The plan this request is served on.

is_keyed.description: Whether the request carried a valid API key. Without an `X-API-Key`, the call runs anonymously at the rate limit for calls without a key.

ParseDetection.description: What invowerk detected about the source document, from its bytes.

syntax.description: Syntax of the source document: 'ubl' or 'cii'.

flavor.description: Rule set of the source, read from its CustomizationID: 'xrechnung', 'peppol_bis', 'factur_x', 'en16931' or 'unknown'.

customization_id.description: The CustomizationID (specification identifier, BT-24) of the source, if any.

ParseResponse.description: The answer of POST /v1/parse: the invoice as JSON and what invowerk detected.

model.description: The invoice as JSON keyed on Business Terms. It has the schema of the POST /v1/generate request body (GenerateRequest), so you can edit it and create the invoice again.

source.description: Where the XML came from: 'xml' (you sent XML) or 'pdf-embedded' (taken from a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF).

PostalAddress.description:
A postal address (BG-5 seller, BG-8 buyer).

EN 16931 requires only the country. XRechnung also requires city and post
code for the seller. invowerk does not check that the address exists.

country_code.description: Country code, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. 'DE' (BT-40 seller, BT-55 buyer).

RateLimitInfo.description:
How many requests you may still make in the current window. These are the
same numbers as the `X-RateLimit-*` response headers. `limit` is the size of the
window, `remaining` what is left of it, and `reset` how many seconds until
it refills (not a timestamp). All three are `null` in the rare case the
counter cannot be read; treat that as "unknown", not zero.

RenderResponse.description: The answer of POST /v1/render?format=json: the HTML and what invowerk detected.

html.description: The rendered invoice as a complete HTML document.

flavor.description: The detected rule set, e.g. 'xrechnung', 'peppol_bis' or 'unknown'.

syntax.description: The detected XML syntax, e.g. 'ubl_invoice' or 'cii'.

RuleExplanation.description:
The explanation of one rule code in the requested language.

It explains the format rule and how to fix the invoice data. It is not tax
advice. ``explain_url`` links the page for the code in the same language.

standard.description: Source of the rule: 'EN16931', 'XRechnung', 'ZUGFeRD' or 'invowerk' (IW-* hints).

bt_refs.description: The EN 16931 Business Terms the rule is about, e.g. 'BT-10'.

causes.description: Common reasons why the rule fails.

fixes.description: How to fix the invoice data.

xpath_hints.description: XPaths of the fields the rule checks.

explain_url.description: Path of the explanation page: /codes/<CODE>, /en/codes/<CODE> in English.

ScenarioInfo.description: The rule set that was applied: its configuration and scenario.

config.description: 'kosit-xrechnung' (the KoSIT configuration for XRechnung and EN 16931) or 'zugferd' (the FeRD rules for ZUGFeRD / Factur-X).

name.description: The scenario name as the configuration states it.

SelfValidation.description:
The result of invowerk's own check of the generated XML.

Only in the ?format=json answer. It shows that the XML passed the check
before it was returned.

valid.description: Always true. An invalid result returns HTTP 500 instead.

lane.description: Which check ran; always 'local' (invowerk's own check).

finding_count.description: Number of findings of the check; all of them are non-fatal.

vat_id.description: Seller VAT ID, e.g. 'DE123456789' (BT-31). Needed when a line has VAT category 'S' (BR-S-02).

contact_name.description: Seller contact name; required for XRechnung (BT-41).

contact_phone.description: Seller contact phone; required for XRechnung (BT-42).

contact_email.description: Seller contact email; required for XRechnung (BT-43).

electronic_address.description: Seller electronic address, e.g. an email address (BT-34).

Syntax.description: The XML syntax of the invoice: UBL or CII.

TaxBreakdown.description: One VAT breakdown: the totals for one VAT category and rate (BG-23).

category.description: VAT category code, e.g. 'S' for standard rate (BT-118).

rate.description: VAT rate of the category in percent (BT-119).

ValidationResponse.description:
The result of POST /v1/validate. Always HTTP 200: a failed check is data,
not an error.

valid.description: The overall result. For the XML, the KoSIT validator decides when it answered (verdict_source 'official'); otherwise invowerk's own check decides (no fatal finding). A fatal problem with the PDF of a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X invoice always makes it false.

verdict_source.description: 'official' when the KoSIT validator decided the XML result, 'local' when invowerk's own check did (ZUGFeRD or Peppol rules, or KoSIT did not answer).

local_verdict.description: invowerk's own result, 'valid' or 'invalid': 'invalid' when any format, business rule or PDF finding is fatal.

disagreement.description: True when the KoSIT validator and invowerk's own check reach different results for the XML. The KoSIT result decides; the findings explain the difference.

lane.description: 'official' when invowerk asked the KoSIT validator (even if it did not answer), else 'local'.

official_verdict.description: The KoSIT validator's result: 'valid', 'invalid' or 'unavailable' (it did not answer). Null when it was not asked, e.g. for ZUGFeRD or Peppol.

pdfa_verdict.description: PDF/A check of a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF with veraPDF: 'valid', 'invalid' or 'unavailable'. Null when not checked (always for XML). Null does not mean the PDF is fine.

detection.description: What invowerk detected from the bytes: kind, syntax, flavor, customization_id, is_hybrid_pdf. For a PDF it describes the embedded XML.

findings.description: All format, business rule and PDF findings as one ordered list.

rulesets.description: The rule set versions used for this check, as {name: version}.

hints.description: Extra observations by invowerk (IW-* codes), e.g. a wrong IBAN check digit. They never change valid, verdict_source or e_rechnung_de.

ValidatorVersions.description: The software versions that produced the result.

appkit.description: The version of the platform invowerk runs on, or 'unknown'.
